application.name: Stereo Disparity
application.description: Disparity and depth from a rectified stereo pair with holoscan-stereo-disparity's StereoDisparityOp on every VPI backend the platform has, from a synthetic scene checked against ground truth or from a recorded camera clip checked against the camera's own depth, shown colorized on a HoloViz display.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-stereo-disparity demo, with a synthetic source checked against ground truth, a recording player checked against the camera's depth, and a HoloViz display.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: OFA
hardware.description: The Optical Flow Accelerator of Jetson Orin or Thor, for the ofa and pva backends.

synthetic.description: Match 300 frames of a rendered scene with every backend the platform has and with auto, check them against ground truth, and show the first backend's disparity when a display is available.

recording.description: Play a recorded RealSense clip from $HOLOSCAN_TEST_DATA/stereo-camera/, show its disparity, and compare the depth with the camera's own. Choose another clip with --run-args.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic frames through every backend the platform has and auto, verified against ground truth; on a CI runner, auto must choose ofa on a Jetson and cuda on x86_64.
